caveats: The current run remains a prefix at the stated cutoff; absence of a later checkpoint is not run completion.
The current full-source predictor-off continuation and earlier standard-source CFD differ in solver/source lineage; their differences are descriptive and not a one-factor causal estimate.
The n=gamma and n=1 arms share the model's assumed compact geometry and Cd; agreement is an internal consistency check, not independent experimental validation.
The reduced ODE has one representative tank and two branches; CFD reports both tanks separately and the table averages their native seat flows and withdrawals.
CFD tank inventory and withdrawal use VOF alpha volume. They are not water-mass measurements for the finite-water EOS run.
Headspace p/T values are local probes, not volume-weighted gas means. The pressure comparison therefore mixes local CFD samples with bulk-model pressure and is a screening comparison.
No fit, valve coefficient adjustment, or thermal-exponent fit was performed. No validation gate is claimed.

current_solver.restart_qualification: Cold-derived predictor-off history resumed operationally from the accepted 0.090771166664 s checkpoint after the prior bundle hit its disk guard. The continuation retained 14 native fields plus dgdt and uniform/time; full-apparatus bitwise continuity is not claimed.

measurement_definitions.native_Q: Sum the second numeric data column, sum(alphaPhi0.water), over seat A1+A2 and B1+B2; the first data column after time is face area and is excluded. Positive seat-zone flux is read from the frozen face-zone convention. Mean Q is the average of the two tank totals.
measurement_definitions.pressure: Mean of two local p point probes in tank headspaces. CFD point probes are not tank-volume means; reduced-model pressure is bulk gas pressure.
measurement_definitions.probe_alignment: Every p/T probe is interpolated to the exact full-precision tank/seat sample time; at a prefix endpoint only, the nearest probe row is accepted within its 8-digit printed-time rounding bound (5.1 ns). No extrapolation beyond that representation bound. Model histories are bracket-interpolated at the same time.
measurement_definitions.tank_inventory: Native volFieldValue volIntegrate(alpha.water) in each tank cellZone. Reported as VOF volume, not EOS water mass.
measurement_definitions.withdrawal: Initial native tank alpha.water volume minus sampled tank alpha.water volume; mean of tanks A and B, converted to litres. The reduced model uses its own t=0 tank-water volume.

record.purpose: Hash-frozen source for momentumPredictor setting and headspace-probe fields/locations.

prior_cfd.source_family: earlier standard-source DCEC cold case; not a matched momentum-predictor-only control for this full-source Pno continuation

source_closure_qualification.conclusion: The public closure record cited by the first-step energy packet describes the 07 ancestor lineage. It is not an exact, verified source closure of the immediate 12d8 binary parent. The 12d8 run has its own frozen source-tree and reused-binary records, but this packet does not include a complete patch/diff chain from the 07 closure to every compiled 12d8 source path.
